reconstructed_malformed_quote: With MBC, you can quickly send commands from your batch jobs to your CICS regions to coordinate file access, dynamically enable or disable programs, transactions, and TDQs, launch transactions, send terminal messages, and more.
source_exact_quote_replacement: With MacKinney Batch to CICS (MBC), you can quickly send commands from your batch jobs to your CICS regions to coordinate file access, dynamically enable or disable programs, transactions, and TDQs, launch transactions, send terminal messages, and more.
